reason_plain: You came to the hospital because of a fast, irregular heartbeat and shortness of breath.
summary_plain: You were treated for a new fast and irregular heart rhythm called atrial fibrillation. Your doctors gave you medicines to control your heart rate, thin your blood, and raise low potassium levels. You are now stable and ready to continue your recovery at home.
warning_signs: Heart racing or pounding that will not slow down
Sudden weakness, numbness, face drooping, or trouble speaking
Unusual bleeding, black or tarry stools, or blood in urine

medications.name: Metoprolol succinate ER
medications.how_to_take_plain: Take 1 tablet by mouth once daily.

medications.name: Apixaban (Eliquis)
medications.how_to_take_plain: Take 1 tablet by mouth twice daily (morning and evening). Do not skip doses.

medications.name: Potassium chloride ER
medications.how_to_take_plain: Take 1 tablet by mouth once daily for 7 days with food, then stop.

medications.name: Ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin)
medications.how_to_take_plain: Do not take. Use acetaminophen for pain instead.

todos.title: Pick up new prescriptions
todos.why_plain: Your new prescriptions were sent electronically for you to start taking.
todos.call_script: Hello, my name is Anjali Talwar. I am calling to see if my new discharge prescriptions are ready for pickup.

todos.title: See primary care doctor
todos.why_plain: To review your hospital stay and your new medicines.
todos.call_script: Hello, my name is Anjali Talwar. I recently left the hospital and need to schedule a follow-up visit with Dr. Chen within 7 days.

todos.title: Fasting blood test
todos.why_plain: To recheck potassium and kidney function while on the new medications.
todos.prep_plain: Nothing to eat or drink except water for 10–12 hours before the draw.
todos.call_script: Hello, my name is Anjali Talwar. I am calling to confirm my lab visit for a fasting blood test.

todos.title: See a heart doctor
todos.why_plain: For management of your new atrial fibrillation and anticoagulation.
todos.prep_plain: Bring your medication list to this visit.
todos.call_script: Hello, my name is Anjali Talwar. I recently left the hospital and need to schedule a follow-up appointment with Dr. Okafor within 2 weeks.
